title: Gomoku, the line of five confirmed as its own result
why: The end only a placement game reaches, recorded and replayed. It pins the version 4 vocabulary end to end: the reason five-in-a-row is written, read back, and agreed with by the replayed adjudication, and the cross-field rule that keeps it to the games whose rules produce it holds for the file the core itself wrote. Its bytes are the corpus's gomoku-15-five-in-a-row golden.
